title: In-godot asset store markdown oddities
body: ### Tested versions Only tested in Godot v4.7.beta3 - macOS Tahoe, not relevant before the asset store is in place, don't have a device handy right away to check if present on windows, but I imagine it's the same. ### System information Godot v4.7.beta3 - macOS Tahoe (26.5.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 (Apple7) - Apple M1 (8 threads) - 16.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description Sorry if this is already tracked elsewhere, but I couldn't find any related tickets: With the new asset store pages, we get some really nice features for styling and creating structures in the store page about that asset - something I was sorely waiting for with the old library system. However, the marking rendering online is not quite as sophisticated as the one in Godot itself: - Custom links/external images appear to not work (but, they are at least gracefully skipped over as a new line - and tbh, this may be more secure to not support loading third party urls) - Bullet points appear appear with extra bullet points between each entry - Paragraphs have weird word wrapping, seems like it's pre-rendered into newlines instead of being done client side/aware of the newline wrapping point - Youtube video's buttons look broken, which disincentivizes plugin creators from adding videos since to a user, it looks like the asset itself might be broken/not maintained. - Weird extra horizontal spacing of thumbnails in the grid I totally get we don't have a full-fledged markdown parser in Godot, and that's totally fine - but there's clearly some kind of conversion being done, so these are a few of the places that could be at least improved without changing actual styling in Godot itself (though ofc, having full markdown rendering would be awesome, and make the user experience more consistent on the web and in Godot): Here's one example (not my own asset btw): https://store.godotengine.org/asset/levinzonr/godot-asset-placer/ Store screenshot at the moment: In Godot's UI: (not pictured above, but the header "discord" status button is rendered as an empty line in godot - tbh that's a perfectly fine graceful fallback, and good to not liter the UI in Godot with a bunch of external things like that) ### Steps to reproduce 1. Find any asset store listing that has markdown features like longer paragraphs, 2. Compare in Godot 4.7 latest beta ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) n/a
